evals.prompt: Prototype this: I want to sanity-check the state machine for order fulfilment before I build it.
evals.expected_output: Builds a throwaway runnable terminal app that pushes the state machine through cases.
assertions: Picks the logic branch (runnable terminal app) for a state-model question
Marks the prototype as throwaway and places it near the real module
Provides one command to run it
Keeps state in memory with no persistence and prints full state after every action
No tests, no polish, no abstractions

evals.prompt: Let me try a few designs for the settings page. Mock up some options.
evals.expected_output: Builds several radically different UI variations switchable on a single route.
assertions: Picks the UI branch and generates several radically different variations
Variations are switchable from one route via a URL search param
Ends by deleting the prototype or absorbing the validated decision into real code

evals.prompt: Implement the production-ready export endpoint with tests and error handling.
assertions: Does not build a throwaway prototype
